display.purpose: Large editorial headlines and compact statistic or step labels.

body.purpose: Navigation, explanatory copy, and readable supporting text.

components.name: Primary Action Link
components.description: Square, filled anchor for the primary registration action.
components.css: .ds-action-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.15rem; background: var(--teal); color: #fff; font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-action-link:hover { background: #5c7f7f; color: #fff; } .ds-action-link:focus-visible { border-radius: 2px; outline: 3px solid var(--soft-text); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Compact wordmark and sign-in navigation on a deep-charcoal band.
components.html:
NILL / WRAP-UP
Accedi
components.css: .ds-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--deep); } .ds-header-inner { width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 64px)); min-height: 76px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.55rem; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand span { color: var(--soft-text); } .ds-nav-link { color: var(--soft-text); font-family: var(--body); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.24em; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { border-radius: 2px; outline: 3px solid var(--soft-text); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-header-inner { width: calc(100% - 40px); min-height: 68px; } }

components.name: Statistics Index
components.description: Definition-list index of statistic labels and short descriptions, divided by fine rules.
components.html:
Messaggi pubblicati
Quanti messaggi hai scritto nel periodo scelto.
components.css: .ds-stat-list { margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-stat-item { padding: 0.85rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-stat-item dt { color: var(--text); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-stat-item dd { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--soft-text); font-family: var(--body); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Verification Step
components.description: Ordered verification row with a typographic zero-padded number and supporting explanation.
components.html:
1. Indica il tuo MID

    Il MID identifica il tuo profilo anche se in seguito cambi nickname.
components.css: .ds-verification-steps { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: verification-step; } .ds-verification-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem minmax(150px, 0.65fr) minmax(0, 1.35fr); gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.15rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); counter-increment: verification-step; } .ds-verification-step::before { content: "0" counter(verification-step); grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; color: var(--soft-text); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-verification-step h3 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; margin: 0; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-verification-step p { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; max-width: 58ch; margin: 0; color: var(--soft-text); font-family: var(--body); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-verification-step { grid-template-columns: 2rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.4rem 1rem; } .ds-verification-step::before { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; } .ds-verification-step h3 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; } .ds-verification-step p { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; } }

narrative.overview:
The public wrap-up reads as one dark editorial sheet: charcoal stock, restrained photocopy grain, light ink, and muted teal details. Display headlines use self-hosted Barlow Condensed; Verdana-style sans text keeps explanations and navigation familiar and readable. The homepage's five-stat index is deliberately uneven and editorial rather than a row of cards.

The build is tonal and flat, using thin rules and changes in charcoal value instead of elevation. Actions are square, high-contrast links. The Barlow Condensed font file is bundled with its SIL Open Font License.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous charcoal sheet with subtle repeating photocopy grain.
Condensed uppercase display paired with readable Verdana-style body text.
Muted teal marks links, rules, and the primary action; the CTA remains square.
Editorial lists and verification rows use rules and alignment, not card containers.

rules.name: The Charcoal Stock Rule
rules.body: Keep the page in the verified charcoal range; use muted teal and light ink as accents rather than introducing unrelated hues.

dos: Do use the bundled Barlow Condensed face for display and the Verdana-style stack for reading text.
Do keep primary actions square, high-contrast links with a visible keyboard-focus outline.
Do use charcoal layering, grain, and fine rules to create print depth without elevation.
Do keep personal recap content private and derived from the member's own Nill data.
donts: Don't invent activity values, rankings, comparisons, or another member's data.
Don't turn the editorial index into a row of equal cards or add unsupported visual colors.
